data.title: Senior Paid Media Strategist
data.content_html:
SENIOR PAID MEDIA STRATEGIST

ROLE OVERVIEW

A Senior Paid Media Strategist at CTC is a full-funnel expert across both paid search and paid social. You operate as the lead media strategist for your client portfolio, combining deep Paid Media mastery to drive outcomes across the entire paid media ecosystem. You analyze data, develop strategy, execute with precision, and communicate results with clarity. You elevate everyone around you.

 

WHAT WE LOOK FOR

This place isn't for everyone, but it might be for you if…

 

YOU SET THE STANDARD

  • Your decisions are research-backed, every time
  • Your client service is the bar others aspire to
  • You arrive at meetings prepared, with data, insight, and a point of view
  • You organize your time and say "no" so you can protect what's most critical
  • You approach failure with curiosity, not defensiveness
  • Your word is trustworthy, and you do what you say you will

YOU ARE DRIVEN TO INCREASE VALUE

  • You're passionate about building brands for the next generation
  • You articulate your expertise so clearly that even a beginner follows along
  • You document and report your work habitually
  • You gather context before meetings, so you arrive ready to contribute

YOU CREATE AN ENVIRONMENT OF EXCELLENCE

  • You seek opportunities to sharpen your skills without being prompted
  • You resist the temptation to play victim; you own outcomes 100%
  • You're willing to put in the reps to be a domain expert
  • You inspire others through the standard you hold for yourself

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

INNOVATE

You stay on the frontier of paid media strategy and technology across both search and social. You combine data analysis and client feedback to develop strategic plans spanning Google Ads and Meta. You make tactical recommendations for targeting, messaging, and campaign optimization across platforms. You test constantly, investigate relentlessly, and adapt strategy based on statistical outcomes. When it's time to pivot, you're among the first. You bring early insights to the team and lead the way.

 

CREATE

Creative problems take creative solutions. You write compelling direct-response copy for both search and social, build out campaigns in Google Ads and Meta Ads Manager, and ensure every initiative is launched on time, on budget, and built to win. You use historical data to guide decisions and find the hidden solution others miss. Attention to detail, proactive problem-solving, and data-driven decision-making are non-negotiables.

 

OWN

KPIs are your bread and butter. Google Sheets is your jam. "Count on Me" is your mantra. You see things through to the end. You project monthly budgets for each account, back every recommendation with data, and communicate results clearly to clients and teammates. You hold yourself to a high standard and share your learnings to elevate the buyers around you. People know: if you're involved, it gets done.

 

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

SUCCESS IN YOUR DAY-TO-DAY

  • Optimize ad accounts across Google and Meta, building, testing, and iterating on campaign types, ad copy, creative, budgets, and bids to hit spend and ROAS targets
  • Monitor active campaigns and adjust budgets and strategy in real time for the best results
  • Forecast future budgets and performance using historical data and industry trends
  • Run multivariate tests to determine the best-performing creative, copy, and audiences
  • Pull and sort data tables to guide creative teams on top-performing elements
  • Troubleshoot accounts for errors and warnings across Google Ads, Google Merchant Center, and Meta Ads Manager
  • Communicate meaningful results to clients in weekly meetings, reports, and team debriefs
  • Coach and assist junior buyers, sharing knowledge to uplift the full team

 

SUCCESS IN YOUR FIRST THREE TO SIX MONTHS

Ownership of Ad Accounts

Actively running client accounts across paid search and paid social without regular assistance from other buyers.

 

Accurate Reporting and Projecting

You've learned the ropes, you can accurately project a client's spend and ROAS across both Google and Meta.

 

Assisting Wherever Possible

You share your knowledge freely, assist accounts owned by non-Sr. buyers, and operate palms-down to help wherever you can.

 

WHAT YOU'LL BRING TO THE TABLE

  • Significant experience creating and optimizing Google Ads accounts at scale. This is a top requirement; if you haven't done this, this role isn't for you
  • 2–4+ years of paid media experience managing budgets of $350,000+ across search and/or social
  • Expert-level knowledge of: Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, Google Merchant Center, Google Analytics, Shopify, and copywriting
  • Experience building, connecting, optimizing, and troubleshooting data feeds in Google Merchant Center
  • Experience integrating Product Ratings from various aggregators into Google Merchant Center
  • Ability to forecast budgets across channels based on historical data and client goals
  • Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills. You analyze data, make decisions, and build recs from it
  • Familiarity with Google Ads Desktop Editor
  • Ability to think about a brand's 360° digital approach from acquisition through retention
  • Confident interpersonal communicator. You can hold people accountable and lead difficult conversations
  • Insatiable curiosity. You can't leave a problem alone until you've found a solution
  • A desire to take calculated risks after carefully examining the calculus
  • A unique combination of humility (willing to do the dirty work) and ambition (vision for what's ahead)
  • Skilled in Asana or relevant project management software, preferred
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to organize, prioritize, and manage multiple tasks with great attention to detail
  • Ability to adapt to new processes, strategies, and goals

 

COMPENSATION

  • Base Salary: $103,333 annually
  • Bonus Structure: 10% of base salary

ABOUT US

At CTC, we are fixated on building the next generation of legendary brands and the people who will lead them.

To give ourselves our best shot at accomplishing this mission, we organize all of our decisions — from recruiting, to hiring, to raises, to promotions, to how we spend our time and money — in the direction of three committed values.

We recognize these values aren't for everyone. They're challenging.

In fact, they're so challenging, that's why we invest so much in supporting our team and why we tend to attract people who are craving the opportunity to do more at work than get a paycheck. We're looking for those who are interested in making their work significant.

For those who resonate with the following values, CTC has proven itself to be a remarkable place to grow and thrive.

  1. We Set the Standard
  2. We Are Driven To Increase Value
  3. We Create an Environment of Excellence

 

We’ll come alongside you and care for you in your pursuits by offering full-time permanent CTC employees:

  • 401K | program with a 3% company match (post 90 days employment) to bring out the investor inside you
  • TIME OFF | When you’re at CTC, you’re firing on all cylinders. To make that possible, we offer a Flexible Time Off policy where you will coordinate with supervisor to take time away from the office for rest, travel, and variety of others things that are important to you!
  • MEDICAL | Full health, dental, and vision benefits that fit your lifestyle and goals
  • WELLNESS | A wellness reimbursement program that inspires 360 degrees of health: mentally, physically, and spiritually

 

CTC is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We Embrace I.D.E.A. and are committed to fostering a culture of performance and inclusivity.

 

Common Thread Collective provides this Privacy Notice for California Consumers/Employees only to individuals residing in the State of California who are considered “Consumers” under the CCPA and from whom we collect “Personal Information” as described in the CCPA (“Consumers”). This CCPA Employee Privacy Notice sets forth our privacy practices as required by the California Consumer Privacy Act of 2018 (“CCPA”). We provide you this notice because, under the CCPA, California Residents who are employees, employee applicants, or contractors qualify as Consumers. For purposes of this CCPA Employee Privacy Notice, when we refer to Consumers, we mean you to the extent you are a California employee, employee applicant, or contractor. To see our full policy, please click here.

data.title: Paid Media Analyst
data.content_html:
Real people. Real service.

At SupplyHouse.com, we value every individual team member and cultivate a community where people come first. Led by our core values of Generosity, Respect, Innovation, Teamwork, and GRIT, we’re dedicated to maintaining a supportive work environment that celebrates diversity and empowers everyone to reach their full potential. As an industry-leading e-commerce company specializing in HVAC, plumbing, heating, and electrical supplies since 2004, we strive to foster growth while providing the best possible experience for our customers.

We are looking for a Paid Media Analyst to join our Growth Marketing Team in our Marketing department. This individual will report into our Paid Media Manager and support the execution, optimization, and reporting of multi-channel paid media campaigns across search, shopping, social, video, and retargeting platforms. Working closely with partners across Marketing, Analytics, and Creative, this role will leverage data analysis and structured testing to improve campaign performance, increase efficiency, and help ensure our marketing investments deliver measurable business impact. If you’re passionate about digital marketing, enjoy digging into data to uncover opportunities, and are excited to optimize campaigns that drive profitable growth, we’d love to hear from you!

This remote position is open to individuals who live in, or are open to relocating to, the following states: Arizona, Delaware, Florida, Georgia, Kentucky, Nevada, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Ohio, Rhode Island, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Virginia, and Washington.

This position requires travel to our headquarters in Melville, NY 3 times per year for internal meetings and team building activities. We reimburse reasonable and necessary travel expenses, and you’re also welcome to work on-site anytime beyond these visits – our doors are always open.

Role Type: Full-Time, Exempt

Location: Remote 

Schedule: Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. with time zone flexibility 

Base Salary: The expected starting salary for the position is $64,295 to $80,369 within a full position range of $64,295 to $96,433 annually. This range reflects the long-term earning potential for the role. Our starting pay practice is the minimum to middle portion of the range, depending on experience, qualifications, and internal equity, consistent with applicable law and it is rare for a new hire to start above the midpoint.

Responsibilities:

  • Support daily management of paid media programs, including Paid Search, Shopping, Paid Social, Retargeting, Streaming TV, and Video campaigns
  • Execute and optimize search engine marketing (SEM) campaigns across Google Ads and Microsoft Ads, ensuring efficiency, coverage, and accuracy
  • Assist with budget pacing and allocation of decisions based on performance data, test outcomes, and overall campaign objectives
  • Design and implement structured campaign experiments to enhance ROI, conversion efficiency, and account scalability
  • Build and optimize remarketing and retargeting campaigns across search, social, and display environments to improve customer engagement and retention
  • Support launch and performance tracking of video campaigns across YouTube, paid social, and streaming TV platforms
  • Monitor and analyze performance of product launches, promotions, and seasonal campaigns; synthesize data into actionable insights
  • Prepare recurring reports and dashboards that communicate performance trends, testing outcomes, and recommendations to marketing leadership
  • Collaborate with the Paid Media Manager and cross-functional teams to align campaign execution with broader marketing and growth initiatives
  • Partner with platform representatives to stay informed on emerging features, beta programs, and industry best practices
  • Maintain accurate campaign documentation and clean account structures to ensure reliable tracking, consistency, and long-term scalability

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Statistics, or a related business field
  • 3+ years of paid search strategy and execution experience
  • 1+ year of paid social, retargeting, and display experience
  • 1+ year of TV, CTV, and Demand Gen experience
  • Experience supporting and optimizing spend to reach budget goals
  • Strong analytical and decision making skills
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Strong experience with Microsoft Office products, especially Excel data analysis

Why work with us: 

  • We have awesome benefits – We offer a wide variety of benefits to help support you and your loved ones. These include:
    • Comprehensive and affordable medical, dental, vision, and voluntary life insurance options
    • 401(k) with up to 4% company match
    • Paid vacation, sick time, and holidays
    • Company-paid basic life insurance and long-term disability
    • Discounted auto, home, and pet insurance programs
    • Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
    • Confidential mental health, financial planning, and legal support through our Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
    • Company-provided equipment and one-time $250 work from home stipend
    • $750 annual professional development budget
    • $25 monthly Grubhub credit
    • Company rewards and recognition program
    • And more!
  • We empower ownership – We all contribute to our success and we all share in it. Our Ownership for All program ensures each SupplyHouse team member will benefit financially from the company’s growth and accomplishments.
  • We promote work-life balance – We value your time and encourage a healthy separation between your professional and personal life to feel refreshed and recharged. Look out for our wellness initiatives and ask about our Flex-Time Policy!
  • We support growth – We encourage you to embrace continuous learning and take on new challenges. In an exciting and evolving industry, we provide opportunities for career growth through our annual merit and bonus opportunities, hands-on training, diversity and inclusion initiatives, internal mobility options, and professional development budget.
  • We give back – We live and breathe our core value, Generosity, by giving back to the trades and organizations around the world. We make a difference through donation drives, employee-nominated contributions, support for non-profit organizations, Volunteer Paid Time Off, and more.
  • We listen – We value hearing from our employees. Everyone has a voice, and we encourage you to use it! We actively elicit feedback through our monthly town halls, regular 1:1 check-ins, employee listening initiatives, and company-wide ideas form to incorporate suggestions and ensure our team enjoys coming to work every day.

Check us out and learn more at: https://www.supplyhouse.com/our-company!

Additional Details: 

  • Remote employees are expected to work in a distraction-free environment. Personal devices, background noise, and other distractions should be kept to a minimum to avoid disrupting virtual meetings or business operations.
  • Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the U.S. on a full-time basis. SupplyHouse.com will not sponsor applicants for work visas.
  • SupplyHouse.com is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We welcome and encourage individuals of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives to apply. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs.
  • To ensure fairness and trust in our hiring process, we ask that all application materials, assessments, and interview responses reflect your own thinking and perspective. You may use AI tools to assist in preparing your responses, as long as this use is clearly disclosed and you can speak authentically to your ideas and work. Our focus is on honesty, judgment, and how you approach problem-solving. We appreciate your transparency and look forward to learning more about your skills.
  • We are committed to providing a safe and secure work environment and conduct thorough background checks on all potential employees in accordance with applicable laws and regulations.
  • All emails from the SupplyHouse team will only be sent from an @supplyhouse.com email address. Please exercise caution if you receive an email from an alternate domain.

pay_ranges.blurb:
The listed Pay Range reflects the total cash compensation inclusive of annual base salary and annual bonus as applicable. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonus target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Apollo and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location. Applicants interested in this role who are not located in the US may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.

Additional benefits for this role may include: equity; company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; 401(k) plan; at least 10 paid holidays per year, flex PTO, and parental leave; employee assistance program and wellbeing benefits; global travel coverage; life/AD&D/STD/LTD insurance; FSA/HSA and medical, dental, and vision benefits.

data.content_html:
Apollo.io is the leading go-to-market solution for revenue teams, trusted by over 500,000 companies and millions of users globally, from rapidly growing startups to some of the world's largest enterprises. Founded in 2015, the company is one of the fastest growing companies in SaaS, raising approximately $250 million to date and valued at $1.6 billion. Apollo.io provides sales and marketing teams with easy access to verified contact data for over 210 million B2B contacts and 35 million companies worldwide, along with tools to engage and convert these contacts in one unified platform. By helping revenue professionals find the most accurate contact information and automating the outreach process, Apollo.io turns prospects into customers. Apollo raised a series D in 2023 and is backed by top-tier investors, including Sequoia Capital, Bain Capital Ventures, and more, and counts the former President and COO of Hubspot, JD Sherman, among its board members.

Your Role & Mission

As the Senior Manager of Paid Acquisition, you will own Apollo.io's performance marketing engine across all paid channels. You will lead a team of highly proficient channel specialists, driving scalable, efficient growth through Paid Search, Paid Social, Connected TV, Audio, OOH, and emerging channels. You'll operate as both strategic architect and hands-on operator, setting the vision for how paid acquisition fuels Apollo's growth while staying close enough to the data to drive results directly. You'll be a key voice in our growth strategy and a culture-builder who raises the bar for the team around you.

Responsibilities

  • Lead and develop a high-performing team of paid channel specialists across Paid Search (Google, Bing), Paid Social (Meta, LinkedIn, Reddit), TV, Audio, OOH, and adjacent channels.

data.title: Sr. Paid Advertising Strategist
data.content_html:
Senior Paid Advertising Strategist

About Reunion Marketing

Reunion Marketing is a dynamic, data-first digital marketing agency specializing in the automotive industry. We help clients grow through measurable, performance-driven strategies, innovative campaign execution, and a commitment to continuous improvement.

At Reunion, data beats intuition. We believe strong paid media performance requires more than technical campaign management. It requires strategic thinking, proactive communication, confident client leadership, and the ability to turn insights into action.

We are seeking a Senior Paid Advertising Strategist who can lead high-impact paid search and paid social strategies, influence client outcomes, and help elevate the overall performance standard of our paid advertising team.

About the Role

The Senior Paid Advertising Strategist will own and lead paid advertising strategy for a portfolio of client accounts, with responsibility for campaign performance, strategic recommendations, budget management, client communication, and cross-functional alignment.

This role is ideal for a seasoned paid media professional who is equally comfortable analyzing data, building campaign strategy, presenting performance insights, and influencing client direction. You will serve as a trusted performance advisor for your accounts and help guide clients toward decisions that improve measurable results.

This is not simply an execution-focused role. The Senior Paid Advertising Strategist is expected to think ahead, identify opportunities, solve complex performance challenges, mentor others, and contribute to the continued evolution of Reunion Marketing’s paid advertising approach.

What You’ll Do

Paid Media Strategy & Performance Ownership

  • Own paid advertising strategy, execution, optimization, and performance outcomes across a portfolio of client accounts.
  • Develop and manage campaigns across platforms such as Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, Meta, and other relevant paid media channels.
  • Translate client goals into clear paid media strategies, campaign structures, testing plans, and performance benchmarks.
  • Monitor budgets, pacing, conversion trends, lead quality, cost efficiency, and overall account health.
  • Identify risks, performance gaps, and growth opportunities before they become client concerns.
  • Make proactive recommendations to improve results, increase efficiency, and strengthen client ROI.
  • Lead campaign testing initiatives, including audience strategy, creative testing, bidding strategies, landing page recommendations, and conversion optimization opportunities.

Client Communication & Strategic Influence

  • Serve as a senior subject matter expert on client-facing calls, performance reviews, and strategic planning discussions.
  • Translate complex campaign data into clear, compelling performance narratives that clients can understand and act on.
  • Confidently explain strategy, results, recommendations, and tradeoffs to clients and internal stakeholders.
  • Influence client decision-making by using data, industry insight, and performance trends to support recommendations.
  • Partner with Client Success team members to ensure paid advertising strategy aligns with client goals, expectations, and broader account strategy.
  • Support client retention and growth by demonstrating measurable value and strategic leadership.

Internal Collaboration & Team Leadership

  • Partner cross-functionally with Client Success, SEO, Analytics, Creative, and Development teams to ensure integrated client strategies.
  • Provide guidance, coaching, and support to Paid Advertising Strategists and other team members as needed.
  • Help establish and refine best practices for campaign management, performance reporting, optimization workflows, and client communication.
  • Contribute to internal training, knowledge sharing, and process improvement initiatives.
  • Act as an escalation point for complex paid media performance questions or account challenges.
  • Bring forward ideas that improve team efficiency, client outcomes, and overall department performance.

Reporting, Analysis & Continuous Improvement

  • Analyze campaign data to identify trends, insights, risks, and opportunities.
  • Prepare and present strategic performance updates that clearly connect actions to outcomes.
  • Use data to evaluate campaign effectiveness and recommend next steps.
  • Stay current on paid media platform changes, automation tools, AI-driven advertising capabilities, and industry trends.
  • Continuously test, learn, and refine strategies to improve performance across accounts.

Who You Are

  • You are a confident, strategic, and results-driven paid media professional who enjoys solving complex performance challenges. You are energized by fast-moving environments, comfortable influencing decisions, and motivated by measurable client success.
  • You combine technical platform expertise with strong business judgment and communication skills. You do not wait for direction when performance needs attention. You identify the issue, develop a point of view, and recommend a path forward.
  • You are persuasive without being pushy, analytical without getting lost in the details, and proactive without losing alignment with the broader team strategy.

You’ll Excel Here If You Are

  • A strategic thinker who can connect campaign execution to larger business outcomes.
  • Confident communicating with clients, internal stakeholders, and leadership.
  • Comfortable managing complex accounts, competing priorities, and fast-changing expectations.
  • Highly analytical, with the ability to turn data into clear recommendations.
  • Proactive in identifying opportunities, solving problems, and improving performance.
  • Able to balance autonomy with alignment to agency standards and client strategy.
  • Motivated by results, accountability, and helping clients win.
  • Curious, adaptable, and willing to challenge assumptions with data.
  • Comfortable mentoring others and raising the performance standard of the team.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred.
  • 7+ years of experience in digital marketing, paid search, paid social, or paid media campaign management.
  • Demonstrated experience managing paid advertising strategy for multiple clients or complex accounts.
  • Hands-on experience with platforms such as Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, Meta Ads Manager, Google Analytics, and related reporting tools.
  • Strong understanding of paid search, paid social, conversion tracking, budget pacing, attribution, and campaign optimization.
  • Experience presenting campaign performance, insights, and strategic recommendations to clients or senior stakeholders.
  • Google Ads and/or Google Analytics certifications preferred.
  • Experience with Fluency or other advertising automation platforms is a plus.
  • Automotive industry experience is strongly preferred, but not required.
  • Prior agency experience preferred.

Why Join Reunion Marketing?

  • Strategic Impact: Play a senior role in shaping paid advertising strategy and driving measurable client results.
  • Client Influence: Serve as a trusted advisor who helps clients understand performance, make better decisions, and achieve stronger outcomes.
  • Growth Opportunity: Expand your leadership, strategic planning, and client advisory skills in a fast-paced agency environment.
  • Collaborative Team: Work alongside a team that values data, innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement.
  • Performance-Driven Culture: Join an agency that believes strong strategy, clear communication, and measurable outcomes are the foundation of client success.

data.title: Paid Media Manager
data.content_html:
About Us

Scorpion is the leading provider of technology and services helping local businesses thrive. We do this by helping customers understand local market dynamics, make the most of their marketing, and deliver experiences their customers will love. We offer tools to know what’s going on with marketing, competitors, and customers. We offer a unique blend of AI support and teams of real human people with local expertise committed to customer success. At Scorpion, we are ready to do whatever it takes to help our clients reach their goals. Our technology and personalized tools bring everything together to help local businesses easily understand their unique business, market, and customer needs. We put SEO, Reviews, Advertising, Email Marketing, Chat and Messaging, Social Media, Website, Lead Management, Appointment Scheduling, and more to work for local businesses. We’re a technology-led service with a human touch.

About the Role

Scorpion is looking for a Paid Media Manager to lead paid media strategy and execution across our B2B marketing programs. You’ll manage our paid channel mix with a focus on generating qualified pipeline and revenue.

Paid Search is the largest and most complex part of this role. You’ll lead strategy and hands-on execution across Google Ads, Microsoft Advertising, and Google Demand Gen while also managing Paid Social, Display, CTV, and emerging advertising channels.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You’ll work directly in advertising platforms and performance data, making decisions about budgets, bidding, audiences, campaign structure, testing, and optimization. You’ll also connect paid media performance to MQLs, opportunities, pipeline, and revenue and turn that data into clear insights and recommendations for marketing leadership.

You’ll report to the Senior Director of Demand Generation and partner closely with Demand Generation, Product Marketing, Vertical Marketing, SEO, Marketing Operations, and ABM to ensure paid media investments support Scorpion’s broader pipeline and revenue goals.

What Your Success Will Look Like

  • Lead strategy and hands-on execution for Paid Search and Google Demand Gen campaigns, including campaign structure, bidding, targeting, budgets, testing, and optimization. 
  • Manage paid media across LinkedIn, Meta, TikTok, Display, CTV, and other relevant channels. 
  • Allocate and manage a substantial, multi-vertical paid media budget based on performance, business priorities, and opportunities for growth. 
  • Monitor campaign performance and continuously test creative, audiences, targeting, bidding strategies, and channel mix to improve results. 
  • Measure paid media performance against MQLs, opportunities, pipeline influenced, revenue, and return on investment. 
  • Build reporting and communicate performance, insights, and recommendations to marketing leadership and cross-functional partners. 
  • Evaluate and pilot emerging advertising opportunities, including AI-driven advertising channels, and scale programs that demonstrate results. 
  • Manage relationships with advertising platforms, agencies, and other paid media partners. 
  • Partner across Demand Generation, Product Marketing, Vertical Marketing, ABM, and other marketing teams to align paid media strategy with business priorities. 
  • Provide direction and quality assurance for campaign builds, trafficking, tracking, and other execution support provided by the Marketing Coordinator.

Who You Are And What You Bring

  • Education
    • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Advertising, Business, Communications, or a related field—or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience
    • 5+ years of experience in paid media or digital advertising, with significant hands-on experience managing B2B Paid Search. 
    • Experience managing Google Ads and Google Demand Gen campaigns at scale. 
    • Experience managing paid campaigns across channels such as LinkedIn, Meta, TikTok, Display, and CTV. 
    • Experience managing substantial paid media budgets with accountability for performance and ROI. 
    • Experience working with advertising platform representatives, agencies, or other external partners.
  • Skills
    • Deep knowledge of Paid Search strategy, including campaign structure, bidding, targeting, optimization, and budget allocation.
    • Proficiency with GA4, Google Tag Manager, and advertising-platform reporting tools.
    • Strong understanding of B2B buying cycles and how paid media contributes to lead generation, opportunities, pipeline, and revenue.
    • Ability to analyze performance data and turn it into clear insights and actionable recommendations for leadership and cross-functional partners.
    • Ability to evaluate, test, and optimize new advertising platforms and emerging paid media opportunities.

Our Scorpion Values

  • Winning Mindset: When our clients win, we win.
  • Genuine Care: We only succeed when we are truly invested in our clients and each other.
  • Unmatched Results: We deliver more than expected–and then some–driving the best results and impacting lives.
  • Constant Improvement: We believe there is always a better way. We learn we ask “What if?” we build and then do it again.
  • Unbeatable Teamwork: We come from different backgrounds but have the same vision. We only get there by doing it together, as a team.

Compensation  

We acknowledge that states have passed legislation promoting pay transparency. As a national employer, Scorpion has made the decision to post our expected pay rate or pay range (as applicable) in all our job postings, regardless of geographic location.

  • The base salary range is $110,000 (entry-level) - $135,000 (highly experienced), exclusive of fringe benefits. If you are hired at Scorpion, your final base salary compensation will be determined based on factors such as geographic location, skills, education, and/or experience. Additionally, we believe in the importance of pay equity and consider the internal equity of our current team members as a part of any final offer. Please keep in mind that the range mentioned above is the total salary range for the role. Hiring at the maximum of the range would not be typical in order to allow for future & continued salary growth. 
  • The compensation package may also include incentive compensation opportunities in the form of discretionary bonuses or commissions.

Our Benefits

We invest in our employees by offering them diverse benefits from best-in-class carriers. These benefits provide enough choice and flexibility to keep our employees and their families healthy and happy—today and tomorrow.

  • 100% employer-paid medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • Flexible paid time off, so you can rest, relax, and recharge away from work
  • Paid parental leave
  • Paid cell phone and service
  • Remote office allowance
  • Professional development and development courses
  • Regular manager check-ins to drive performance and career growth through Lattice

Work Location & Flexibility

Scorpion supports a range of work arrangements, including in-office, hybrid, and remote roles. For positions designated as remote, employees who live within commuting distance of a Scorpion office may be asked to work from the office based on team needs, collaboration opportunities, or business priorities. Specific expectations will be discussed during the interview process.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Scorpion is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without regard to race, color, religion or belief, sex, age, national origin, citizenship status, marital status, military/veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, or physical or mental disability. We believe in creating a dynamic work environment that values diversity and inclusion.

[Reasonable Accommodations]

Applicant Privacy

When you click "Submit Application", this will send any information you add below to Scorpion. Before you do this, we think it's a good idea to read through our Privacy Policy. California residents should read our California Privacy Notice. This explains what we do with your personal data when you apply for a role with us, and, how you can update the information you have provided us with or how to remove it.

E-Verify

Scorpion participates in the E-Verify program to confirm employment authorization of all newly hired employees. The E-Verify process is completed during new hire onboarding and completion of the Form I-9, Employment Eligibility Verification, at the start of employment. E-Verify is not used as a tool to pre-screen candidates. For more information on E-Verify, please visit www.uscis.gov.
